nom: Dermalogica Clear Start Clarifying Bacne Spray

avis.texte: Worked fast, worked as stated, easy to use and will buy it and use it whenever needed.

I would actually prefer if this product was similar to a toner, where I can put it on a round and then dab it on parts of my back where I have acne. I'm usually less sensitive to smells and sprays, but whenever I spray this, my throat gets very itchy and it feels so strong in my nose to where I feel the need to cover my nose with my shirt as a "filter". I was almost in a panic state because it felt like the air was contaminated. Not sure what is causing that reaction but for that reason, I am considering to email Dermalogica to ask how I can get the contents inside without spraying into the air... as I do not want to throw this product in the trash.

After using it for 3 whole months I can say for sure that this product does help w/ body acne. Even if I don't use it daily it clears up the acne quickly - only takes 3-4 times after the acne first shows up.

I had been at my wits end with my bacne, even going to the derm and asking for help with him saying it looked fine (it wasn't). Then this went on sale and i decided to take a chance. There's still a bit that needs to clear up but it made a lot of good ground so far

avis.titre: One of a kind product for bacne
avis.texte: I am so happy a company finally made a treatment to deal with body acne. After a week of daily use, I started to notice my body acne was becoming less angry and healing a lot quicker than usual. Now a few months later, my body acne has dramatically improved. The product smells wonderful with hints of citrus, lavender, and tea tree. I love the formula. It is packed with lots of wonderful ingredients to balance, brighten and to prevent hyperpigmentation. The witch hazel, tea tree oil and lavender help to soothe and balance sebum production. The salicylic acid <3, grapefruit, lemon, tangerine extracts brighten skin and exfoliate the skin. Licorice root extract helps to prevent hyperpigmentation. The spray at any angle is simply great. I'm on my fourth bottle already and I am obessed.

Quality, effectiveness, how many uses, the smell, the bottle, its all amazing. 10 out of 10. Thank you Dermalogica!
This product is great! My daughter has seen a huge difference. She uses it after the shower and prior to working out. It's been a game changer for her.

avis.titre: Seems to work but horrible product design
avis.texte: As others have said, it has a very strong odor, which I actually found pleasant. But unlike others have said, this product is extremely difficult to use. There's no cap, just a small plastic knob with a lock icon. You're supposed to turn it to line up with a line on the base. After removing the protective seal, it was already difficult to turn. There are no grips, and whether I gripped lightly or hard, it just turns the entire top, not the knob. When I'm finally able to unlock it (the lock icon and line are not lined up), it will not press at all. I don't know how others are able to dispense this upside down or with one hand, or maybe one finger. I will even try pressing it while holding it on a hard surface in front of me and putting all my weight on the button, but it doesn't budget. It just kinda oozes. The few times I've been able to dispense something, it seems to work. It took a lot longer than 60 seconds to dry, more like 5-6 minutes. I think this may be because of the poor design that when I am able to dispense it, it doesn't spray wide but more direct, so I think it was applying too heavy with a single spray. I'm going to contact the manufacturer because I think I received a faulty product. I will still recommend this because the rare times it dispensed from the canister it worked. But it sure is an expensive can that entraps the product.

No more bending over to slather creams, lotions, and toners on hard to reach places! The upside down spray changed my life. My skin finally feels SMOOTH. I used to use a glycolic toner for my body but this is faster and more effective.
